name: dynamic-context-budget
explain: Calculate dynamic context window token budgets with guaranteed generation headroom and knapsack evidence packing. Allocates tokens across system instructions, tool schemas, and conversation history, packing only evidence that fits the remaining budget.
steps: Deduct fixed prompt overhead and reserved output headroom from the model context limit. || Pack candidate evidence passages greedily by relevance score, discarding items that exceed the remaining allowance.
expect: Dynamic budget allocation verified: input=5000/5888, headroom=2048, admitted=['doc_1_high_relevance', 'doc_2_mid_relevance']

name: conversation-sliding-compaction
explain: Implement multi-tier conversation memory combining a sliding window of verbatim recent turns, recursive bulleted summaries of older history, and an immutable entity ledger that prevents catastrophic forgetting.
steps: Maintain recent conversational turns verbatim for immediate dialogue flow. || Compact older turns into a bulleted summary while updating structured entity key-values in a persistent ledger.

name: lost-in-the-middle-mitigation
explain: Demonstrate Liu et al. 'Lost in the Middle' attention degradation and mitigate it using U-shaped context reranking. Positions the most relevant evidence at the start (primacy) and end (recency) of the prompt context.
steps: Analyze attention degradation in the middle of long context windows. || Distribute retrieved documents in a U-shape, placing rank 1 at index 0 and rank 2 at the final index.

name: kv-cache-prefix-reuse
explain: Demonstrate KV (Key-Value) cache prefix reuse across prompt requests. Static system prompts and tool definitions placed in byte-identical leading prefixes enable GPU KV cache reuse; dynamic timestamps bust prefix caching.
steps: Place static system instructions and tool schemas in an immutable leading prompt prefix. || Verify that dynamic suffix additions reuse cached prefix attention states without re-evaluating static tokens.
expect: KV cache prefix reuse verified: static_prefix_cached=True (prefill=6 tokens), dynamic_busted=False

name: bpe-tokenizer-vs-heuristics
explain: Demonstrate why character heuristics (1 token = 4 chars) fail on JSON source code and non-Latin multilingual text. Exact Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenization prevents prompt truncation and out-of-budget crashes.
steps: Compare heuristic character token counts against exact BPE tokenization across JSON payloads and Arabic script. || Measure error rates exceeding 100% on formatted code and multi-byte UTF-8 text.
expect: BPE token boundary analysis: JSON (chars=996): heuristic=249, true_bpe=498; Arabic (chars=1020): heuristic=255, true_bpe=850

name: release-gate
explain: Release gates combine quality, critical invariants, and rollback readiness. A strong average score cannot override a permission violation.
steps: Record each mandatory release condition independently. || Block release if any critical condition fails.

name: compression-exception-audit
explain: Audit prompt compression pipelines to prove extractive compaction preserves decisive exceptions and negations. Catches regressions where compression removes critical legal qualifiers.
steps: Extract mandatory negation and exception signals from input policy text before compression. || Execute post-flight audit asserting that all decisive qualifiers survived extractive compaction.
